title: 第十一章 拜访玉阳宫主第十二章 斩妖盛会
lines: 东宁府，一座酒楼的三楼雅间，这一层也仅有这一雅间。
云符安惬意喝着小酒，听着小曲。
一旁有青衣女子一边拨弄着琴弦，一边轻声吟唱着。这让云符安摇头晃脑很是沉醉。
一曲唱毕。
“香茵，你如今这曲子是唱得越加出神入化了，我的心都快被你唱化了。”云符安笑眯眯道。
“云大哥，你过誉了，我还差的远，还需和老师好好学。”青衣女子说道。
“不一样不一样，你那位老师技艺是高明，但年龄大了，那嗓子唱出来哪能及得上你？所以啊，这一行还是看天赋，你这嗓子就是一绝，唱什么都好听。”云符安夸赞道。
“那我再给云大哥你唱一曲。”青衣女子捂嘴一笑，便又拨弄琴弦。
她当然得哄着这位云符安。
云家那位老祖宗一共有五子一女，其中老大老二老三，成长过程中吃尽苦头，和父亲一同经历劫难，如今都是无漏境高手，有两位都是悟出‘势’的，手腕极厉害，被称作是‘云家三雄’。反而老四老五以及最后的小女儿，都没吃多少苦头。
像云符安，在他孩童时，父亲就成了神魔。日子过的逍遥自在。云家老祖那时候刚突破，一心修行巩固自身，没顾得上管教孩子。所以后面三个孩子都有些不成器。
云符安倒是有些特殊，因为是最小的儿子，从小混迹在一堆公子当中，倒是油滑的很。
察言观色、踩人捧人都做的利索，对于诸多肮脏手段也是门清……所以云家三雄还挺喜欢这个弟弟，很多事情都放心让弟弟去做，弟弟也能将事情做得漂漂亮亮。
所以，云符安手中拥有着大量权力！家族的许多事都是他负责。
他一句话，可以让一位名角从这世间消失，一句话让某个女子得到热捧成为名角。
“嗯~~”云符安听着曲子，还轻声跟着哼着。
忽然酒楼下面喧哗起来，声音颇大，这让云符安微微皱眉。
雅间本就隔音，这顶楼三楼又仅有这一间，还是很安静的。可现在吵杂声的确有些大。
“怎么回事？”云符安皱眉开口，“阿福，下去看看怎么回事？”
“是，老爷。”门外的仆人立即下去。
很快，那仆人就回来了，在门外连说道：“老爷，出了大事了。”
云符安一伸手，青衣女子立即停下琴声。一旦有正事，是决不能影响这位云老爷的，她很清楚分寸。
“进来说。”云符安吩咐。
仆人推门进来，低声道：“不但是这酒楼，怕是整个东宁府都热闹了，都是因为孟川公子。”
“他有什么事？”云符安皱眉，嘴角带着一丝不屑。对如今整个孟家他都不太瞧得起。他云家是蒸蒸日上，那孟家却是走下坡路。
“在镜湖道院，孟川施展出了落叶刀秘技三秋叶，甚至击败了镜湖道院原本的大师兄——脱胎境圆满的‘吴琦’，成为现如今镜湖道院的大师兄。”仆人说道，“能施展秘技，还能以洗髓境层次，击败脱胎境圆满层次……他显然悟出刀法秘技了，老爷——”
“出去！”
脸色完全阴沉下来的云符安一声喝斥。
仆人立即不敢吭声，乖乖出去，同时带上了门。
云符安坐在那沉默了下，又起身走到了窗户处，打开窗户，外面街道上的声音一下子大了起来。
“孟川。”“秘技。”等字眼依稀能听到。
显然这件事成为整个东宁府如今最受瞩目的事了。
“这小子还真突破了？”云符安脸色阴沉，“哼，悟出秘技又怎样？成神魔还差得远。”
哐当。
直接关上了窗户。
整个东宁府，其他三大神魔家族也觉得有趣！因为云家前不久，刚刚解除婚约，还正是云青萍和孟川的婚约。
若是知道孟川能十五岁掌握秘技，云家怕就是另一番决定了。
可一位绝世天才诞生，可能性是多么的低？
云家又不敢拖！
因为一般情况下，定下婚约，十八岁就得成亲，因为二十岁就得服兵役。云家不敢拖，自然越早解除越好。
“才掌握秘技，离成神魔还远得很。”云家也只能这么安慰自己。
镜湖孟府。
“阿川，你给我说实话，你是不是在和我打赌的时候，就已经突破了？”柳七月盯着孟川。
content_en:
Dongning Mansion, a private room on the third floor of a restaurant, the only private room on this floor.
Yun Fuan was drinking wine and listening to songs comfortably.
There is a woman in green clothes playing the strings of the piano and singing softly. This made Yun Fu'an shake his head in intoxication.
Finished singing the song.
"Xiangyin, you are singing this song more and more superbly now. My heart is almost melted by your singing." Yun Fu'an said with a smile.
"Brother Yun, you are exaggerating. I am still far behind. I still need to study hard with the teacher." said the woman in green.
"It's different, it's different. Your teacher is very skilled, but as he gets older, how can his singing voice be as good as yours? So, this profession still depends on talent, and your voice is one of a kind. Everything you sing is good." Yun Fu'an praised.
"Then I'll sing you another song, Brother Yun." The woman in green covered her mouth and smiled, then strummed the strings again.
Of course she had to coax this Yun Fu'an.
The ancestor of the Yun family has a total of five sons and one daughter. Among them, the eldest, the second and the third, suffered a lot while growing up and experienced disasters with their father. They are now masters of the Wuluo Realm. Two of them have realized the 'potential' and have extremely powerful skills. They are called the 'Three Heroes of the Yun Family'. On the contrary, the fourth, fifth and last daughter did not suffer much.
Like Yun Fu'an, when he was a child, his father became a god and demon. Live your life in a carefree way. The ancestor of the Yun family had just made a breakthrough at that time and was so focused on cultivating and strengthening himself that he did not bother to discipline his children. So the next three children are somewhat ineffective.
Yun Fu'an is a bit special, because he is the youngest son. He has been among a bunch of young men since he was a child, and he is very naughty.
He is very good at observing people's behavior, criticizing others and applauding them, and he is also good at many dirty tricks... Therefore, the three heroes of the Yun family quite like this younger brother. They can trust his younger brother to do many things, and his younger brother can also do things beautifully.
Therefore, Yun Fu'an has a lot of power in his hands! He is responsible for many things in the family.
One word from him can make a famous actor disappear from this world, and one word from him can make a certain woman become popular and become a famous actor.
"Hmm~~" Yun Fu'an listened to the music and hummed along softly.
Suddenly, there was a loud noise below the restaurant, which made Yun Fu'an frown slightly.
The private room is soundproofed, and it is the only one on the third floor of the top floor, so it is still very quiet. But the noise is indeed a bit loud now.
"What's going on?" Yun Fu'an frowned and said, "Afu, go down and see what's going on?"
"Yes, sir." The servant outside the door immediately went down.
Soon, the servant came back and said outside the door: "Master, something big has happened."
As soon as Yun Fu'an stretched out his hand, the woman in green immediately stopped playing the piano. Once there is something serious, she must not affect Mr. Yun. She knows what to do.
"Come in and talk." Yun Fu'an ordered.
The servant opened the door and came in, saying in a low voice: "Not only this restaurant, but also the entire Dongning Mansion is bustling, all because of Mr. Meng Chuan."
"What's the matter with him?" Yun Fu'an frowned, with a hint of disdain at the corner of his mouth. He doesn't look down upon the entire Meng family now. The Yun family is prospering, but the Meng family is in decline.
"At Jinghu Taoist Academy, Meng Chuan used the secret skill of the Falling Leaf Sword, San Qiuye, and even defeated the original senior brother of Jinghu Taoist Academy - 'Wu Qi' who had perfected the Rebirth Realm, and became the current senior senior brother of Jinghu Taoist Academy." The servant said, "Being able to use the secret skill and defeat the perfect level of Reborn Realm at the level of marrow cleansing... He has obviously figured out the secret skill of the sword technique, Master -"
"Get out!"
Yun Fu'an, whose face turned completely gloomy, shouted.
The servant immediately did not dare to say anything, went out obediently, and closed the door at the same time.
Yun Fuan sat there in silence for a while, then stood up and walked to the window. When he opened the window, the noise on the street outside suddenly became louder.
"Meng Chuan." "Secret skills." and other words can be vaguely heard.
Obviously, this matter has become the most watched thing in the entire Dongning Mansion.
"Has this kid really made a breakthrough?" Yun Fu'an looked gloomy, "Humph, so what if he figured out the secret skill? He's still far from becoming a god or demon."
Clang.
Just close the window.
…
In the entire Dongning Mansion, the other three major gods and demon families also found it interesting! Because the Yun family had just canceled their engagement not long ago, and it was the engagement between Yun Qingping and Meng Chuan.
If they had known that Meng Chuan could master secret skills at the age of fifteen, the Yun family would have made a different decision.
But how low is the possibility of a peerless genius being born?
The Yun family doesn’t dare to delay!
Because under normal circumstances, when a marriage contract is made, you have to get married at the age of eighteen, because you have to perform military service at the age of twenty. The Yun family didn't dare to delay, so naturally the sooner it was lifted, the better.
"I have just mastered the secret skill, and I am still far away from becoming a god or demon." The Yun family could only comfort themselves in this way.
****
Jinghu Meng Mansion.
"Achuan, tell me the truth. Did you already break through when you made the bet with me?" Liu Qiyue stared at Meng Chuan.
